1.consolidated_definition: Jerga. Lenguaje que se restringe a contextos muy informales o a determinados grupos o profesiones. Anglicismo crudo, usual. En Puerto Rico la palabra yankee es un slang y significa alguien alto, con carácter. Daddy Yankee vendría a ser el papá grande (Clarín.com, PR, consultado 17-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Slang. A language that is restricted to very informal contexts or specific groups or professions. Raw anglicism, common in Puerto Rico. In Puerto Rico, the word "yankee" is a slang term referring to someone tall and of strong character. Daddy Yankee would be equivalent to big daddy (Clarín.com, PR, consulted 17-10-08)
